name: TurfFlow — Razorpay Payment Capture to WhatsApp Ticket

parameters.jsonBody:
={

  "recipient_type": "individual",
  "to": "{{ $('Extract Booking & Payment Data').first().json.customerPhone.replace('+', '') }}",
  "type": "text",
  "text": {
    "body": "🎉 *PAYMENT CONFIRMED — TURFFLOW ARENA* 🎉
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎟️ *Pass Ref:* `" + $json.booking.booking_ref + "`
🏟️ *Court:* " + $json.booking.court_name + "
📅 *Date:* " + $json.booking.booking_date + "
⏰ *Time:* " + $json.booking.start_time + " — " + $json.booking.end_time + "
💰 *Paid:* ₹" + $json.booking.total_amount + " (Razorpay Verified)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📍 *Venue:* Plot 42, Sports Enclave, Pune
🗺️ *Maps:* https://maps.google.com/?q=18.5204,73.8567

⚡ Please arrive 10 mins early with flat turf shoes. See you on the pitch! ⚽"
  }
}
